SN.name: Contribution économique locale (CEL: rental value of premises + value added; replaced the patente in 2019)
SN.statute: CGI art. 320-321, 329-330, 336-337 (loi n° 2018-10 du 30 mars 2018; CGI annoté janvier 2025)
SN.doc: art. 330: 15 % of the rental value of rented or freely occupied premises, 20 % of premises entered in the balance sheet; art. 337: 1 % of the previous year's value added (art. 336: products less purchases, external services excluding rents over 3 months, other operating charges and taxes; capped at 70 % of turnover, art. 336-4), at least 0,15 % of turnover. Value added defaults to profit + payroll when the line gives none.
unsupported: 0,075 % minimum for low-margin / regulated-price sectors (art. 337-3, arrêté 011492 of 24 May 2018), telecoms 0,30 % and joint hydrocarbon fields 0,02 % of turnover (art. 337-8/9), port operators 1,5 % (art. 340), simplified-regime limitation to the minimum (art. 337-7), exemptions (art. 322-324), first-year VA exemption (art. 338)

BJ.name: Contribution des patentes (fixed duty on turnover + proportional duty on rental value; Cotonou, 1st zone)
BJ.statute: CGI 2023 art. 199, 202, 204-205 (loi n° 2021-15 du 20 décembre 2021; edition 2023, later finance laws not held)
BJ.doc: art. 202: general tariff, 1st zone 70 000 F up to 1 billion of the previous year's turnover, plus 10 000 F per billion or fraction above; art. 205: proportional duty on the premises' rental value, 17 % in Cotonou and Porto-Novo, at least a third of the fixed duty.
unsupported: importer/exporter tariff on imports and exports (art. 203), 2nd zone (60 000 F) and the other communes' rates (12-25 %, art. 205), household-waste levy 2 000-50 000 F set by councils (art. 199-2), supplementary patente 0,5 % on public contracts (art. 207), first-12-months exemption (art. 198)

NE.name: Taxe professionnelle (formerly patente: 1 per mille of turnover with floor and caps + 10 % of rental value)
NE.statute: CGI 2013 mis à jour LF 2022, art. 174-176 (LF 2025, ordonnance 2024-59, amends only art. 173; LF 2023-2024 not held)
NE.doc: art. 175: fixed duty 1 per mille of the previous year's turnover, at least 150 000 F, capped at 3 M (turnover up to 10 bn), 7 M (10-30 bn), 15 M (30-50 bn), 30 M (above); art. 176: proportional duty 10 % of the rental value of the premises, rented or free, at least a quarter of the fixed duty.
unsupported: specific rates 1,5 % / 3 % of rental value under art. 169 sexies (art. 176), transport-sector taxe professionnelle (section III), new-business and young-entrepreneur exemptions (art. 173)

CM.name: Contribution des patentes (rate on turnover by enterprise size, with floor and cap)
CM.statute: CGI édition 2024, Livre II (fiscalité locale) art. C 10, C 13 (nouveau); same text in the 2026 edition
CM.doc: art. C 13: 0,159 % of the last closed year's turnover for large enterprises (floor 5 000 000 F, cap 2,5 bn), 0,283 % for medium (floor 141 500, cap 4 500 000), 0,494 % for small (floor 50 000, cap 140 000); the amount includes the principal, the local development tax, the chambers' additional centimes and the broadcasting fee (C 13 (2)). Size classes: small below 50 M (regime threshold, art. 93 quater), large from 3 bn (large-taxpayer threshold set by ministerial decision, not printed in the CGI): flagged.
unsupported: class boundaries (3 bn) set outside the CGI (ministerial decision on the tax centres' competence)
activities taxable whatever the turnover (annexe II), one-year exemption of new businesses (art. C 12), licence duties (contribution des licences)
other local taxes listed by the registry (centimes additionnels communaux on IS/IRPP, taxe de développement local) not modelled

ML.name: Contribution des patentes (traders, tableau A exceptional class, Bamako: fixed duty by turnover + 10 % of rental value)
ML.statute: CGI art. 144 and 144-A tableau A (L.F. 2014, L.F. 2015, L.F.R. 2017; DGI online consolidation of 2017, later finance laws not held)
ML.doc: art. 144-A tableau A, exceptional class, trader with turnover excluding tax of at least 1 bn: 1 000 000 F (1st zone, district of Bamako); 600 M to 1 bn: 800 000 F; 300 to 600 M: 600 000 F; art. 144: proportional duty 10 % of the rental value, never below a quarter of the fixed duty.
unsupported: traders below 300 M of turnover (lower classes of tableau A) and the other professions and zones of the tariff
